semiconductor_relevance: High — Onn Wah Tech Pte Ltd provides specialized tooling solutions for the semiconductor back-end packaging industry, which is critical for the assembly and testing phases.
summary: Onn Wah Tech Pte Ltd specializes in precision tooling solutions for the semiconductor back-end packaging industry, offering products such as Ball Mount Tooling, Singulation Tooling, and Test Sockets. The company emphasizes customized semi-automation and precision machining to enhance manufacturing efficiency.
